control.name: svgImageBox
control.description: The SvgImageBox control provides the QueryHoveredItem, ItemEnter, ItemLeave, ItemClick and PopupMenuShowing events to interact with the SVG image's items.The QueryHoveredItem event allows you to specify a custom item as "hovered" when you move the mouse cursor over items. For instance, you can specify a group as "hovered" when you hover over the group's item.

control.name: sizeModeComboBox
control.description: The SizeMode property specifies whether and how the image is stretched.

control.name: hitTestTypeComboBox
control.description: The ItemHitTestType property specifies the item hit-test type.Precise - An item is detected when a point is within the item's graphical path. Group items do not have visible contours, and, thus, they are not hit-tested in this mode.BoundingBox - An item is detected when a point is within the item's bounding rectangle. Groups are hit-tested in this mode when a point is within a rectangle within which all child items lie.

control.name: selectionModeComboBox
control.description: A user can select items by clicking on them with the mouse. Use the SelectionMode property to choose between Single and Multiple item selection modes.

control.name: useCtrlToMultiSelectToggleSwitch
control.windowcaption: Use Ctrl Key in Multiple Selection Mode
control.description: The UseCtrlToMultiSelect property specifies whether a user needs to press the CTRL key to select image items by clicking them with the mouse cursor. This property is in effect in Multiple selection mode.

control.name: selectedItemsListBox
control.description: The SvgImageBox control provides properties and events to manipulate item selection. For instance, the SelectionChanging event can be handled to prevent the selection from being cleared on a mouse click. The Selection property allows you to access currently selected items and modify the selection in code.
